I am a **postdoctoral researcher** in the [BETSAKA project (Biodiversity-economic tradeoff and synergy assessments for conservation areas)](https://paires.hypotheses.org/betsaka-madagascar), conducted jointly by the [Malagasy National Research Center in Development Economics (CERED)](https://albatross-project.eu/consortium/centre-detudes-et-de-recherchers-economiques-pour-le-developpement/) at the [University of Antananarivo](https://www.univ-antananarivo.mg/) and the [French National Research Institute for Sustainable Development (IRD)](https://en.ird.fr/). I am also a part-time lecturer in the [Department of Economics at the Faculty of Economics, Management and Sociology (EGS)](https://mg.linkedin.com/company/facult%C3%A9-egs-economie-gestion-sociologie-universit%C3%A9-antananarivo) of the University of Antananarivo, and a member of the [Doctoral Research Team (EAD)](https://hayka.mg/ed/ecosyst%C3%A8mes-naturels-8) at the ["Ecole Doctorale Écosystèmes Naturels (EDEN)"](https://hayka.mg/ed/ecosyst%C3%A8mes-naturels-8)
 of the [University of Mahajanga](https://www.mahajanga-univ.mg/).

Specializing in climate change and environmental issues, I completed my PhD at the [Ecole Doctorale Ecosystèmes Naturels](https://hayka.mg/ed/ecosyst%C3%A8mes-naturels-8at) under the supervision of [Senior Professor Hery Lisy Tiana RANARIJAONA](https://mg.linkedin.com/in/hery-lisy-tiana-ranarijaona-19707369) and [Senior Professor Heriniaina RAMANANKIERANA](https://mg.linkedin.com/in/heriniaina-ramanankierana-aa9336a8).

Having a background in Applied Mathematics and Statistics with a specialization in Mathematical modeling and Actuarial science during my university studies at [Aix-Marseille University](https://maths.univ-amu.fr/master-mas/les-parcours-de-mas/parcours-ingenierie-mathematique-et-science-actuarielle-imsa/) in France, I gained solid professional experience in statistics, database management and national accounting before moving into research.

You can contact me at my [email adress](mailto:v.ramizason@gmail.com).
